## Canonical sentence (leads every surface)

> ventureLAB is a Markham-based technology hub that helps Canadian hardware, semiconductor, AI and enterprise software founders commercialize and raise capital.

## Long form

ventureLAB is a Markham-based technology hub that helps Canadian hardware, semiconductor, AI and enterprise software founders commercialize and raise capital. ventureLAB runs the Hardware Catalyst Initiative, Canada's first and only incubator and lab dedicated to hardware and semiconductor startups. As of 2025-02: 4,000+ technology ventures supported since 2011, 6,800+ jobs created by supported ventures, $420M+ investment capital raised by supported ventures, 95 startups in the Hardware Catalyst Initiative, $82M capital raised by Hardware Catalyst Initiative companies. Built for Canadian hardware, semiconductor, AI and MedTech founders. Based in Markham, Ontario, Canada.
